import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to;
        long cap;
        long flow;
        int rev;

        Edge(int t, long c, int r) {
            to = t;
            cap = c;
            flow = 0;
            rev = r;
        }
    }

    static class FlowGraph {
        int V, s, t;
        List<List<Edge>> adjList;
        int[] level;
        int[] nextEdge;

        FlowGraph(int nodes, int src, int dst) {
            V = nodes;
            s = src;
            t = dst;
            adjList = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                adjList.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[V];
            nextEdge = new int[V];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long capacity) {
            adjList.get(u).add(new Edge(v, capacity, adjList.get(v).size()));
            adjList.get(v).add(new Edge(u, 0, adjList.get(u).size() - 1));
        }

        boolean buildLevelGraph() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.offer(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adjList.get(u)) {
                    if (e.cap - e.flow > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        long blockingFlow(int u, long flow) {
            if (u == t) return flow;
            for (int i = nextEdge[u]; i < adjList.get(u).size(); i++) {
                nextEdge[u] = i;
                Edge e = adjList.get(u).get(i);
                if (level[e.to] == level[u] + 1 && e.cap - e.flow > 0) {
                    long pushed = blockingFlow(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.cap - e.flow));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        adjList.get(e.to).get(e.rev).flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long computeMaxFlow() {
            long total = 0;
            while (buildLevelGraph()) {
                Arrays.fill(nextEdge, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = blockingFlow(s, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (pushed <= 0) break;
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static int[][] fireDist = new int[150][150];
    static int[][] reachDist = new int[150][150];
    static int[][] cellId = new int[150][150];
    static int gridSize, maxTime;
    static String[] gridData, capacityData;

    static List<int[]> getNeighbors(int r, int c) {
        List<int[]> res = new ArrayList<>();
        if (r + 1 < gridSize) res.add(new int[]{r+1, c});
        if (r - 1 >= 0) res.add(new int[]{r-1, c});
        if (c + 1 < gridSize) res.add(new int[]{r, c+1});
        if (c - 1 >= 0) res.add(new int[]{r, c-1});
        return res;
    }

    static void fireDistanceBFS(int startR, int startC) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(fireDist[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        fireDist[startR][startC] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{startR, startC});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            for (int[] neighbor : getNeighbors(r, c)) {
                int nr = neighbor[0], nc = neighbor[1];
                char cellChar = gridData[nr].charAt(nc);
                if ((cellChar != 'Z' && !Character.isDigit(cellChar)) || fireDist[nr][nc] != -1) continue;
                fireDist[nr][nc] = fireDist[r][c] + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(gridData[i].charAt(j)) && fireDist[i][j] == -1) {
                    fireDist[i][j] = maxTime;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void reachDistanceBFS(int startR, int startC) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(reachDist[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        reachDist[startR][startC] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{startR, startC});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            for (int[] neighbor : getNeighbors(r, c)) {
                int nr = neighbor[0], nc = neighbor[1];
                if (!Character.isDigit(gridData[nr].charAt(nc)) || reachDist[nr][nc] != -1) continue;
                reachDist[nr][nc] = reachDist[r][c] + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        gridSize = sc.nextInt();
        maxTime = sc.nextInt();
        gridData = new String[gridSize];
        capacityData = new String[gridSize];
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) gridData[i] = sc.next();
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) capacityData[i] = sc.next();

        int fireR = -1, fireC = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                cellId[i][j] = i * gridSize + j + 1;
                if (gridData[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    fireR = i;
                    fireC = j;
                }
            }
        }

        fireDistanceBFS(fireR, fireC);

        int totalNodes = 2 * gridSize * gridSize + 2;
        FlowGraph flowNet = new FlowGraph(totalNodes, 0, totalNodes - 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(gridData[i].charAt(j))) {
                    int people = gridData[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    flowNet.addEdge(0, cellId[i][j], people);
                    reachDistanceBFS(i, j);
                    for (int r = 0; r < gridSize; r++) {
                        for (int c = 0; c < gridSize; c++) {
                            if (Character.isDigit(capacityData[r].charAt(c)) && reachDist[r][c] != -1 &&
                                reachDist[r][c] <= fireDist[r][c] && reachDist[r][c] <= maxTime) {
                                boolean allowed = true;
                                if (reachDist[r][c] == fireDist[r][c]) {
                                    allowed = false;
                                    for (int[] neighbor : getNeighbors(r, c)) {
                                        int nr = neighbor[0], nc = neighbor[1];
                                        if (reachDist[nr][nc] != -1 &&
                                            reachDist[nr][nc] < fireDist[nr][nc]) {
                                            allowed = true;
                                            break;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                if (allowed) {
                                    flowNet.addEdge(cellId[i][j], gridSize * gridSize + cellId[r][c], people);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(capacityData[i].charAt(j))) {
                    int cap = capacityData[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    flowNet.addEdge(gridSize * gridSize + cellId[i][j], totalNodes - 1, cap);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flowNet.computeMaxFlow());
    }
}
